# Commit Message Guidelines

This project uses [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).

## Format

```text
<type>: <short description>
```

## Allowed Types

- `feat`: Add a new feature
- `fix`: Fix a bug
- `refactor`: Change code without changing its behavior
- `docs`: Add or update documentation

## Rules

- Write messages in English.
- Use the imperative mood, such as `add`, `fix`, or `update`.
- Keep the first line short and clear.
- Start the description with lowercase and do not end it with a period.
- Keep each commit focused on one logical change.

## Examples

```text
feat: add random question endpoint
fix: validate missing answer fields
refactor: simplify question deletion logic
docs: update API usage examples
```
